text: I see. so every floor is 80kb thats nasty
resolution: Clarifying Q&A (no code): user asked what counts as a 'building' and reacted to the per-piece 80B cost. Explained the engine has no building concept — 'building' is everything on the standard InstanceData path (box/ramp/cylinder/sphere/prism families + material batches), arbitrary composition. Established that per-piece 80B is fine; aggregate cost is dominated by foliage count, which led directly into the grass/bush/flower slim work (req_2019). The generic shape-row slim (~32B, for floors/buildings) is captured as the next pass in project memory.
